title: US real average hourly earnings MoM, September 2026
question: What will the BLS first print for seasonally adjusted real average hourly earnings of all employees on private nonfarm payrolls, over-the-month percent change, be for September 2026?

resolutionRule: Resolve to the first BLS Real Earnings Table A-1 print for September 2026, row 'Real average hourly earnings' under 'OVER-THE-MONTH PERCENT CHANGE' for all employees on private nonfarm payrolls, seasonally adjusted. Outside the interval would likely require an inflation or composition shock larger than ordinary recent monthly noise.
